task.title: Propose a link with Gemini and review it
task.shortdesc: For a requirement with no evidence, proposes one topic, and you approve or reject it as the information architect.

context.p: The model gets only the requirement text and the titles and short descriptions of the candidate topics, never their bodies. Its answer must name a topic that exists in this pack, or none. The public sandbox allows proposals a day.

step.cmd: In a gap row, select Ask Gemini to propose a link.
Read the proposal: the topic, the reason and the confidence.

info.p: A proposal under , or none, becomes a gap note instead.

step.cmd: Select Approve as information architect or Reject.

result.p: An approved link counts for check_coverage at once. It is labelled as a sandbox link in the table, the manifest and the report. In the real flow it would be a pull request to the evidence map.
